title: SRS Package Bundle
description: A distributable package artifact containing Field and Type definitions inlined as objects. Self-contained when mode is 'bundled'; declares external dependencies when mode is 'standalone'. Produced by the package distribution tooling from a package-manifest.json source tree. A bundle written to a file by a package export is one JSON document with the suffix .srspkg (RFC-003 [C5]); a bundle carries definitions only and is never an SRS repository (RFC-003 [C2]).

schemaVersion.description: SRS spec version this package was authored against, e.g. '2.0'.

packageNamespace.description: The source package manifest's namespace, the label that pairs with packageName (the manifest's name). A label: identity remains packageId (RFC-044 [R5]).

dataModelRevision.description: RFC-033 / #265 — the data-model generation this bundle was generated for. Absent means revision 0. The emitter (#259) stamps this so repo stamp, bundle version, and migration-registry generation reference one number. RFC-043 is the migration toRevision 8 (container members become ordered entries; rootInstanceIds and Composition memberOrder removed); a bundle embeds Compositions, so its memberOrder is migrated by the pre-load transformer (RFC-043 [R17]). Not dotted semver.

mode.description: Governs definitions only. bundled: every referenced definition is included inline, except definitions of the RFC-029 core package, which every implementation embeds: those are listed in dependencyRefs and not carried (RFC-003 [C1]). standalone: dependencies are expected pre-installed; dependencyRefs is the required manifest of definition References. packageDependencies (the package requirement list) is checked identically in both modes.

fields.description: Field definitions. In bundled mode, all Fields referenced by any included Type must be present.

views.description: ext:views-l1; omit if not in use.

compositions.description: ext:views-l2; omit if not in use.

vocabularies.description: Vocabulary definitions included in this bundle (RFC-006).

lifecycles.description: Lifecycle definitions included in this bundle (RFC-006).

relationTypes.description: Relation type definitions included in this bundle.

themes.description: Theme definitions included in this bundle (ext:themes-l1; RFC-044 [R6]).

blueprints.description: Blueprint definitions included in this bundle (ext:blueprint; RFC-044 [R6]).

protocols.description: Protocol definitions included in this bundle (ext:protocol; RFC-044 [R6]).

dependencyRefs.description: Required in both modes. Consumers use this to validate completeness without parsing content internals. The list of definition References this bundle's content points at; it is not the package requirement list, which is packageDependencies (RFC-044 [R7]).

packageDependencies.description: The packages this bundle's package requires, with exactly the shape and meaning of package-manifest.json's packageDependencies (RFC-044 [R8]); may be empty. A whole-package export carries the source manifest's list, except that an entry for a package whose every definition the bundle inlines MAY be omitted (RFC-044 [R5]).

readme.description: RFC-045. Optional: the package's readme, its path relative to the package directory (the directory holding package.json; never package.json itself) and its text. Absence is never an error or a warning. If present, an implementation that writes the bundle out as a package directory writes it at path ([R3], [R6]), and any rewrite of the bundle keeps it unchanged ([R5]).

BundledReadme.description: RFC-045. A readme carried by a travelling form: the file's actual path within the artifact and its text. Optional, never required; opaque, so no implementation derives any model fact from it ([R1]). The path rules ([R4]) and the content rule ([R2]) are checked by implementations, not by this schema, so a schema-valid readme can still be invalid (diagnostic readme-invalid).

path.description: The readme's actual path, relative to the root of the artifact this form carries, with '/' separators. Restored at this path on unpack, never over an existing file ([R6]); carried unchanged on every rewrite of the same artifact ([R5]).

content.description: The file's bytes decoded as UTF-8 with no other change: line endings and any byte-order mark are carried as characters. Unicode scalar values only (no unpaired surrogates, [R2]).

fieldType.description: RFC-032 decomposed value type — see field.json $defs.FieldType. Embedded loosely here (additionalProperties:true); the bundle schema mirrors field.json's Field shape.

Type.description: Embedded loosely (additionalProperties:true) mirroring type.json, except that fieldGroups is rejected outright — RFC-039 [R7] removes the construct, and without this clause a bundle carrying one would still validate.

definitionType.$comment: GENERATED — derived from package-manifest.json's ten definition-kind properties by scripts/gen-package-bundle-definition-type.mjs --check (rfc-decision-c8704763 item 4; finding A6). Do not hand-edit this enum.

DependencyRef.description: A requirement on another package (RFC-044 [R1]). packageId is the key; namespace and name are display labels and never decide whether the requirement is satisfied. version is a SemVer 2.0.0 string: an installed version satisfies it when it is in the same compatibility band (same MAJOR; below 1.0 the same 0.MINOR; for 0.0.z the same release), is not a pre-release of a different release, and has equal or higher precedence (RFC-044 [R3]).

packageId.description: The id of the required package: the value its package manifest carries as id and its bundle carries as packageId. The key of the requirement.

namespace.description: Display label: the required package's namespace. Never used to decide satisfaction.

name.description: Display label: the required package's name. Never used to decide satisfaction.

version.description: SemVer 2.0.0 version the requiring package is authored against; satisfied by an installed version under the RFC-044 version rule ([R2], [R3]).
